# Appendix — Battery V: the verifier inside the loop (auto-generated by scripts/problem_loop_analysis.py)

Event-driven verifier feedback injected into the notebook (fb300), plus a deterministic scoreboard every 300 tokens (fbagenda); baselines are battery B's plain and angle arms re-scored in text order. Cell = variant (mean over 2 RNG seeds). gain = best-fit held-out excess minus the notebook's best (higher is better); improvements = candidates that beat the notebook's own training best so far (the verifier's measure of progression); fabricated = '# Verifier:' lines written by the model itself.
